rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: If p_window_days is null or outside 1-90, raise exception LMS-031 with the supplied value; otherwise continue.
rules.notes: Declared parameter is int; no precision handling shown.

rules.title: Skip NPA loans
rules.statement: If asset_class = 'NPA', increment p_skipped and skip the loan entirely.

rules.title: Require benchmark code
rules.statement: If benchmark_code is null on an active floating loan, raise exception LMS-005 including the loan_id.

rules.title: Next reset date calculation
rules.statement: Compute months since disb_date using year*12 + month from age(), round down to multiple of reset_months then add one reset_months interval, then add that many months to disb_date to obtain v_next.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age) without day-count adjustment; no rounding function called.

rules.title: Reset inside window check
rules.statement: If v_next > p_as_of + p_window_days, skip the loan.

rules.title: Notice date weekend adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, else unchanged (next weekday on or after reset).
rules.notes: Uses extract(dow) with no holiday calendar.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new = (most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where benchmark_code matches and effective_date <= v_next, or 0 if none) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: Coalesce to 0 on both benchmark and spread; no rounding call.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old = (most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where benchmark_code matches and effective_date <= disb_date + (v_months - reset_months) months, or 0 if none) + coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: Coalesce to 0 on both benchmark and spread; no rounding call.

rules.title: Minimum rate change threshold
rules.statement: If abs(v_new - v_old) < 0.25, increment p_skipped and skip.
rules.notes: Numeric comparison; no rounding of v_new/v_old before comparison.

rules.title: Duplicate notice suppression
rules.statement: If a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with note starting 'reset ' || v_next, increment p_skipped and skip.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE with wildcard after v_next; checks loan_ledger only.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert into loan_ledger: loan_id, v_notice as entry_date, 'RESET_NOTICE' as entry_type, v_new as amount, note = 'reset ' || v_next || ' from ' || v_old || ' to ' || v_new; then increment p_posted.
rules.notes: Amount column receives the new rate value; no explicit numeric precision declared on insert.

contradictions.description: Header states the procedure posts a RESET_NOTICE for every active floating-rate loan whose next reset falls inside the window; code additionally skips NPA loans, loans with change < 0.25, and duplicate notices, and raises on missing benchmark.

open_questions: Is the extract(year/month) age calculation for reset cycles intended to ignore day-of-month differences?
Should v_new and v_old be rounded to a declared number of decimals before the 0.25 threshold test or before storage?
Is the weekend-only adjustment for v_notice (no holiday table) the intended calendar rule?
